name: Transparent compositing stage

original_specification.name: Transparent compositing stage
original_specification.description: Transparent compositing stage is a conceptual setting for product cutouts for catalogs; compositing. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.
original_specification.representation: Procedural 3D studio with separately managed ambient illumination
original_specification.geometry: Shadow-catching ground without visible backdrop; separate reflection environment
original_specification.ambient_lighting: Neutral lighting remains present in reflections while the camera background has alpha
original_specification.scale_policy: Subjects from 10 mm to 5 m; physically aligned contact plane; preserve subject dimensions; fit the stage once to an explicit selection, never continuously rescale the CAD model
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural geometry and materials; no AI imagery required
validation: Check horizon and ground contact from multiple cameras.
Check diffuse gray, chrome and thick glass references for clipped reflections and background highlights.

generated_geometry.name: Optional coordinate witness - hide for free flight

geometry_summary.units: millimetres Z-up in OBJ; metres Y-up in glTF/GLB

radiance.source_owner: HDR owns distant room/task patches; the separate Sun owns solar energy

background.limitations: Not a photograph or native renderer output; finite scene geometry is provided separately.

limitations: One 1 mm coordinate witness is included solely to keep portable mesh files nonempty; hide or delete it in free-flight scenes.
Procedural family realization with named contextual components; no claim that every physical detail of the concept has been modeled or validated.
Native glTF import retains geometry and scalar appearances, not arbitrary material extensions or textures.
